headline: 今日AI速览：学术研究最活跃
narrative:
今日共收录228篇AI新闻，分类分布：学术研究147篇, 开源项目40篇, 模型发布31篇, 产品/API10篇。热门标签：Agent（56篇）。其中5%的文章有多来源交叉验证。

▸ openai /codex：Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal

▸ mattpocock /skills：Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

▸ affaan-m /ECC：The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research

▸ obra /superpowers：An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.

▸ Wei-Shaw /sub2api：Sub2API 一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、Openai 、Gemini、Grok订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。
